name: fusion_change_detection
description: Learned bi-temporal change detection via multimodal evidence fusion — combines optical pixel-difference evidence, optional SAR backscatter-difference evidence, and optional temporal-gap evidence through a logistic-regression fusion model whose weights are trained (training/fit_fusion_model.py), not a fixed threshold on one signal. Unlike change_detection (pixel diff only) or vlm_change_detection (CLIP embedding distance only), this fuses several independent signals; any missing channel (no SAR pair, no dates) is passed through as neutral evidence rather than biasing the result. Ships with an unfitted informative-prior model until a checkpoint is fitted; fusion_model_fitted in the result says which.

image_t1_path.description: Path to the earlier (pre-change) optical/multispectral image

image_t2_path.description: Path to the later (post-change) optical/multispectral image

sar_image_t1_path.description: Optional: path to a SAR image of the same area/time as image_t1_path, for cross-modal evidence

sar_image_t2_path.description: Optional: path to a SAR image of the same area/time as image_t2_path

date_t1.description: Optional: ISO 8601 acquisition date/time of the T1 image, for temporal evidence

date_t2.description: Optional: ISO 8601 acquisition date/time of the T2 image

modality.description: Modality of the primary (optical) pair, used only for labeling the summary

change_map_path.description: Path to the fused change map

change_summary.description: Natural language summary of the fused decision

changed_area_pct.description: Percentage of the scene flagged as changed by the fused model

change_embedding.description: Flattened grid of per-cell fused change probabilities

evidence_channels_used.description: Which evidence channels actually contributed real (non-neutral) evidence: any of optical, sar, temporal

fusion_model_fitted.description: Whether a trained checkpoint was loaded, vs. the unfitted informative prior

applied_shift_px.description: {optical: [dy, dx], sar: [dy, dx]} co-registration shifts applied before differencing
